data.name: Afandi
data.gender_notes: Afandi is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'afad' which means 'to understand, to learn'. The name Afandi is a title of respect and honor, given to those who are intelligent, wise, and knowledgeable. In Islamic history, the title was bestowed upon scholars, teachers, and spiritual leaders. The name Afandi carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afandi usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of knowledge and wisdom.
data.etymology: Afandi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afandi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أفندي
in_arabic.meaning: أفندي يعني السيد أو المربي أو الحاكم
in_arabic.long_meaning: أفندي هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني السيد أو المربي أو الحاكم، و يوحي بالعز والرفعة و المكانة العالية. و هو من الأسماء التي كانت تستخدم في العصر العثماني للإشارة إلى السادة أو الأعيان.

in_urdu.name: افندی
in_urdu.meaning: افندی کا مطلب ہے سید یا مربّی یا حاکم
in_urdu.long_meaning: افندی ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے سید یا مربّی یا حاکم۔ یہ نام عزت، رفعت اور بلند مقام کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अफंदी
in_hindi.meaning: अफंदी का अर्थ है सेढ़ या मربی या हाकिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफंदी एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है सेढ़ या मربی या हाकिम। यह नाम सम्मान, गरिमा और उच्च पद की ओर संकेत करता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.long_meaning: افندی یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او معنی یې د سيد یا پالونکی یا واکمن دی. دا نوم د عزت، لوړوالی او لوړ مقام نښه کوي. دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتونو په دودیزو کړاوو کې کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Afandi
in_english.meaning: Afandi means a title of respect for a gentleman or a master
in_english.long_meaning: Afandi is derived from Arabic and used as a title of respect for a gentleman, master, or a person of high social status. It is associated with elegance, refinement, and intellectualism. The term has been used historically in various Muslim cultures, particularly during the Ottoman Empire, to address scholars, nobles, and people of distinction.
